resources.string: Diagnostic only. Select one 1344×2992 opaque sRGB PNG screenshot, then run three AVIF encodes. Compare source and output, record visual findings and save the JSON report.

Your screenshot stays on this device. No Internet permission, automatic upload, gallery write or production export. Only your explicit Save Report action writes metrics outside this app. Sampling may affect timings; the measured PSS maximum is not an exact peak.
